scope: Real feasible frozen uniquely matched rectangular-grid packets with all endpoint grid edges and every all-BT gap edge; explicit even-r coverage witnesses, selector lifts, actual odd-r empty-set Tutte witnesses, explicit signed block identities and positive packet ledgers; complete repairs by distinct old interval units through two mixed relays per source. General parity exclusion, half-progress lower bound and arbitrary mixed activation are written proofs. No general grid inequality counterexample and no new Lean validation.
